Remove Duplicate Lines

Remove duplicate lines from a list while preserving the first occurrence, with case-sensitivity, trimming and sorting options.

✓

Operation Completed Successfully

How to use Remove Duplicate Lines

  1. Paste a list with one item per line.
  2. Choose case-sensitivity, trimming and sorting options.
  3. Click Remove duplicates, then copy or download the result.

Frequently asked questions

Which occurrence is kept when a duplicate is found?

The first occurrence of each line is kept; later duplicates are removed.
